page-structure.evidence: No h1 on page (axe page-has-heading-one, best-practice). Two banner landmarks exist (#navbar-main <header> and #gw-desktop-herotator div[role=banner]) violating landmark-no-duplicate-banner and landmark-banner-is-top-level. Footer content in navFooterLinkCol divs is outside all landmarks (axe 'region'). Heading tree: h2 at top, then aria-level=6, then h5 in footer — skips h3/h4. The footer has role=heading aria-level=6 headings mixed with h5 elements with no programmatic grouping of the four footer columns (Get to Know Us, Make Money with Us, etc.) as a fieldset or group.
